name: Eastern Animal Hospital
hoursText: Urgent care hours: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM - 11:00 PM; Sat 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sun 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
evidenceQuote: Our hospital offers urgent care services through day-of drop-off appointments. Please note that we do not accept walk-ins for urgent care. Schedule Arrival Time: If available, our staff will schedule a convenient arrival time for the same day. Patients are triaged based on the severity of illness/injury.
rejectedReason: Its own evidence quote defeats it: 'we do not accept walk-ins for urgent care' — day-of drop-off appointments only. Fails Rule 2. The Maryland pass excluded it for the same reason.

name: Hollymead Veterinary Hospital
evidenceQuote: We understand that health concerns don't always come with notice. That's why we're open 7 days a week until 8 pm with same-day availability for urgent care needs.
rejectedReason: Advertises 'same-day availability', not walk-in, and the western-Virginia pass found 'call ahead to ensure we're ready'. Formerly VETSS (an ER), now converted to general practice. Charlottesville keeps coverage via VVSE (24/7) and Autumn Trails.
